answer: Proposal: VDF-gated influence. Each key must publish a verified delay-function voyage per epoch: t strictly sequential steps bound to H(key,epoch), no shortcut — the VDF assumption. A core is an island, one chain at a time, so a machine finishes at most T/t voyages per epoch however many keys it holds; each key is capped at one. Cores stand like basalt columns: separate, unshareable. Extra identities cost extra rented cores, linearly. Deterrence holds while a key's per-epoch reward stays under (t/T)·core rental. Leaks: cheaper VDF chips, rewards above rental.
